claim: allantoicase has a definable active site
finding: yeast allantoicase crystal structure 2.6 A; two totally conserved surface patches, one per jelly roll; hexameric packing concentrates them into the probable active site
confidence: high for fold and patches; site inferred from conservation and packing, no ligand complex; no SITE records in either entry; full text not open access

claim: human ALLC retains pocket residues and geometry
finding: 51 positions invariant across 12 active allantoicases, human matches 49/51; clustering gives 19+23 residue patches; 40/42 identical in human; median CA deviation 0.42 A, median side-chain centroid deviation 0.49 A; per-domain RMSD 1.17 A and 0.91 A
confidence: high for geometry; model not structure; 2 loop outliers are alignment artefacts

claim: pocket is under purifying selection in mammals
finding: pocket dN/dS 0.042 vs rest 0.161, Fisher OR 0.29 p=1.9e-64; paired Wilcoxon 67/67 pairs p=1.1e-12; exposed pocket 0.076 vs 0.170 (p=3.9e-15), buried 0.030 vs 0.140 (p=5.9e-27)
confidence: high for direction and size; NG86 pairwise; p-values inflated by non-independence

claim: mammals show relaxed selection on the pocket vs urate-degrading species
finding: matched window dS 0.05-0.60 (median 0.464 vs 0.496, p=0.082): pocket 0.043 (627 mammal pairs) vs 0.028 (193 fish pairs); rest 0.190 vs 0.238; independent-pairs relative constraint 0.231 [0.124-0.365] vs 0.125 [0.044-0.259], difference 0.103 [-0.061,0.260] p=0.224; 4/42 positions less retained in mammals at BH q<0.05 (T102, N108, E72, M230), 0/42 reverse
context: 84 mammals on human CDS; 63 ray-finned fish on zebrafish allc (CDS translates exactly to Q6DGA6)
confidence: moderate-high; whole-pocket clade difference is a NULL result; amphibians unusable (1 Anura orthologue, tetrapod-fish dS saturated)

claim: the monomer pocket is the functional site
finding: 60 chain-A residues contact another subunit within 4.5 A; 20/42 patch residues at an interface with reciprocal patch1-patch2 contacts; mammalian non-patch interface dN/dS 0.355 vs 0.156 exposure-matched control, OR 1.83 p=3.3e-29; best-mapped 33 positions 0.366 vs 0.155, OR 1.91 p=6.2e-29
context: 1SG3 assembly 1 (D3 homo 6-mer) transferred to human, median CA deviation 0.58 A
confidence: moderate; assumes mammalian oligomer uses the yeast interface; no experimental oligomeric state for any mammalian ALLC

finding: HEPN survey: dimer reconstruction showed why these calls require oligomeric validation
no activity detected from predicted pseudoenzymes, purified or unpurified
context: fungal metallocarboxypeptidases in Sf9 and HEK293T
confidence: different family; shows structure retention is not an activity prediction

finding: oe_lof 0.889 [0.691-1.157], 40 obs vs 45.0 exp, pLI 9.2e-13, oe_mis 0.990, mis_z 0.099; p.Trp161Ter AF 1.11e-3 with 2 homozygotes, p.Arg89Ter 1 hom, p.Glu194AsnfsTer5 2 hom, p.Trp234Ter truncates an invariant pocket residue; HPRT1 0.210, PGK1 0.111, URAD 0.866, UOX no record
confidence: high; different timescale from mammalian dN/dS; testis-restricted gene with mild fertility effect need not be LoF-depleted

claim: ALLC is expressed where an allantoate-metabolising enzyme would act
finding: tissue enriched, detected in single tissue, testis 15.6 nTPM; early spermatids 155.0 nCPM, late primary spermatocytes 95.9 nCPM; HPA protein evidence at transcript level
confidence: moderate; transcript level only; GTEx v10 and v8 returned zero rows so GTEx was NOT used

claim: the human gene makes a full-length product
finding: allantoicase cDNA expressed in adult testis, prostate, kidney and fetal spleen; 5' region lacked a continuous ORF, attributed to incorrect splicing
confidence: moderate; reference sequence is now a complete 391-residue ORF

claim: mammalian ALLC encodes an active allantoicase
finding: 11-exon gene structure in mouse and human plus an exon-1-less transcript; functional statement is background only: activity of allantoicase is absent in mammals, birds and reptiles
confidence: this one sentence is the ECO:0000305 basis for 'Probable inactive allantoicase' on Q8N6M5, Q9JHX6, Q6AYP0, Q2KIG4 and Q4R964; no assay of the cloned product

finding: Xenopus laevis allantoicase Km 8.44 mM, Vmax 6.94 umol/min/mg in kidney extract
confidence: high for Xenopus; only direct vertebrate kinetics found; no mammalian equivalent
